decisions.decision: Continue from consolidated/final as the inherited ChatGPT implementation baseline.
evidence: git ancestry: codex/chatgpt-tree-consolidation 0 behind and consolidated/final 22 ahead
decisions.invalidateWhen: Branch ancestry changes or a different integration branch is explicitly selected.

decisions.decision: Use PowerShell batch discovery and grouped failure signatures by default.
decisions.invalidateWhen: A task requires a purpose-built tool or PowerShell cannot provide the required evidence.

decisions.decision: Do not certify a capability from file presence or sampled evidence alone.
decisions.invalidateWhen: Never; evidence requirements may only become stricter.

decisions.decision: Apply full verification to identity, authorization, finance, insurance, database migrations and transactional integrity.
decisions.invalidateWhen: Never; regulated or safety-critical scope may expand.

decisions.decision: Treat token reduction, zero-token operations and statistical confidence figures as targets until measured.
decisions.invalidateWhen: A reproducible benchmark establishes replacement values.

decisions.decision: Use OpenAI as the governed execution and model layer while retaining the existing Claude-authored frameworks as the supporting architecture.
evidence: Existing consolidated implementation and governance registries
decisions.invalidateWhen: The user explicitly changes the project-wide provider or framework policy.
